adjustment.description: An adjustment: a function applied to everything beneath the layer. Exactly one key names its kind (`Invert` is the bare string).

Levels.description: Levels: the per-channel records are applied first, then `master` to every channel.

black.description: The black ink channel when `space` is Cmyk.

gamma.description: Midtone gamma, 1.0 = unchanged. out = ((in - in_black) / (in_white - in_black)) ^ (1 / gamma), then scaled to out_black..out_white.

master.description: One Levels record; all values on the 0.0 to 1.0 scale except `gamma`.

gamma.description: Midtone gamma, 1.0 = unchanged. out = ((in - in_black) / (in_white - in_black)) ^ (1 / gamma), then scaled to out_black..out_white.

per_channel.description: Three records in the order `space` names.

items.description: One Levels record; all values on the 0.0 to 1.0 scale except `gamma`.

gamma.description: Midtone gamma, 1.0 = unchanged. out = ((in - in_black) / (in_white - in_black)) ^ (1 / gamma), then scaled to out_black..out_white.

space.description: Which channels `per_channel` addresses: Rgb = red, green, blue; Cmyk = cyan, magenta, yellow (values are 1 - ink) plus `black`; Lab = lightness, a, b (stored 0.0 to 1.0), and `master` is ignored.

Curves.description: Curves: the per-channel curves are applied first, then `master`. A curve with fewer than 2 points, or exactly (0,0),(1,1), is the identity.

black.description: The black ink curve when `space` is Cmyk. Empty: identity.

pencil.description: False: each curve is a smooth spline through its points. True: each curve has 256 points (input k/255 for k = 0..255) and is evaluated by straight segments between them.

per_channel.description: Three curves in the order `space` names.

space.description: Which channels `per_channel` addresses: Rgb = red, green, blue; Cmyk = cyan, magenta, yellow (values are 1 - ink) plus `black`; Lab = lightness, a, b (stored 0.0 to 1.0), and `master` is ignored.

exposure.description: Stops: the value is multiplied by 2^exposure.

vibrance.description: -100 to 100: saturation change weighted towards unsaturated colours.

HueSaturation.description: Hue/Saturation: master values (or the Colorize colour) plus six hue ranges.

colorize.description: True: every pixel takes the hue and saturation above and keeps its own lightness.

hue.description: Master hue shift in degrees, -180 to 180 (with `colorize`: the hue, 0 to 360).

lightness.description: Master lightness change in percent, -100 to 100.

ranges.description: Reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, in that order.

bounds.description: Hue degrees `[fade-in start, fully-on start, fully-on end, fade-out end]`. May wrap past 0/360.

saturation.description: Master saturation change in percent, -100 to 100 (with `colorize`: the saturation, 0 to 100).

preserve_luminosity.description: True: the result keeps each pixel's luminosity.

tint.description: A tint colour applied to the gray result. Null: no tint.

weights.description: Percent contribution of reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas to the gray value; typically -200 to 300.

matrix.description: One row per output channel: red, green, blue.

items.description: `[from red, from green, from blue, constant]` as fractions (1.0 = 100 %).

monochrome.description: True: the first row gives a gray output written to all three channels.

dither.description: True: ordered dither of plus or minus half an 8-bit step.

lut.description: Null: no table is stored (a lookup Photoshop keeps as an ICC profile); the adjustment then changes nothing.

size.description: Entries per axis: the table holds size^3 RGB triplets.

oneOf.description: Invert: every colour channel value v becomes 1 - v.

levels.description: Number of tonal levels per channel, 2 to 255.

level.description: 0.0 to 1.0: pixels whose luminosity is at or above it become white, the rest black.

GradientMap.description: Gradient Map: each pixel's luminosity (0.0 to 1.0) picks a colour from the gradient.

dither.description: True: ordered dither of plus or minus half an 8-bit step.

reverse.description: True: the gradient is traversed backwards.

stops.description: Gradient stops, location 0.0 to 1.0, colour components 0.0 to 1.0.

adjustments.description: Reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks, in that order.

items.description: `[cyan, magenta, yellow, black]` change in percent, -100 to 100.

relative.description: True: changes are relative to the ink already present. False: absolute.

Unsupported.description: An adjustment imported from a PSD file that PhotoCraft cannot evaluate. It changes nothing when rendered. Its original bytes travel in the layer's `x.photocraft.psd-blocks` node (slot `adjustment`).

psd_key.description: The 4-character PSD key of the adjustment block.

blendClipped.description: True: a clipping group composites as a whole in the base layer's blend mode.

blendInterior.description: True: inner glow, satin and the overlays are merged with the content before fill opacity and blend mode apply.

knockout.description: Which layers beneath are punched through by this layer's shape: none; to the bottom of the enclosing group; to the bottom layer.

layerMaskHidesEffects.description: True: the layer mask hides the effects instead of shaping them.

transparencyShapes.description: True: the layer's transparency limits its effects and knockout.

vectorMaskHidesEffects.description: True: the vector mask hides the effects instead of shaping them.

m.description: `[a, b, c, d, e, f]`: x' = a*x + c*y + e, y' = b*x + d*y + f.

artboard.description: An artboard: its group clips its children to `rect` and paints `background` behind them.

background.description: What is painted behind the artboard's contents.

preset.description: The size preset the board was made from. Empty: custom.

blend_if.description: Value ranges outside which the layer's pixels are hidden.

ranges.description: Entry 0 is the composite gray of the colour channels; then one entry per colour channel of the document's mode. Empty: every pixel blends.

items.description: One slider pair on the 0 to 255 scale, whatever the document's depth.

black.description: `[low, high]`: below `low` the pixel is hidden; between `low` and `high` it fades in linearly.

white.description: `[low, high]`: above `high` the pixel is hidden; between `low` and `high` it fades out linearly.

blend_mode.description: How a layer or effect is combined with what lies beneath. The formula of every mode is in spec/PROFILE-RASTER-LAYERS.md section 5.2.

char_style.description: A character style. Sizes are in points: pixels = points * resolution_dpi / 72.

font_family.description: Family name, e.g. "Inter". Empty: the reader's default family. The font file is NOT in this package unless the structure node's `fonts[].source` names a node that carries it; the layer's `cache` is its rendered appearance.

font_style.description: Face name as shown to the user, e.g. "Bold Italic". Informational; `weight` and `italic` decide.

kern.description: Manual kerning in 1/1000 em between this character and the next, added to the automatic kerning.

kerning.description: Automatic pair kerning: from the font; computed from glyph outlines; none.

leading_pt.description: Baseline-to-baseline distance in points. Null: automatic (the paragraph's `auto_leading` times the size).

postscript_name.description: PostScript name of the exact face, when known.

style_sheet.description: The `id` of the character style (in the `core.raster.text-styles` node) this run uses. Absent: none.

color.description: A colour with alpha, as normalised numbers.

alpha.description: Opacity, 0.0 transparent to 1.0 opaque (straight, not premultiplied).

c.description: Up to four colour components in the order `mode` gives; unused ones are 0. Nominal range 0.0 to 1.0; a 32-bit float document may hold values outside it.

color_mode.description: A colour model. Rgb, Indexed, Multichannel: components are red, green, blue. Grayscale, Bitmap, Duotone: one component, 0.0 black to 1.0 white. Cmyk: cyan, magenta, yellow, black as INK amounts, 0.0 no ink to 1.0 full ink. Lab: lightness L*/100, then (a* + 128)/255 and (b* + 128)/255.

color_stop.description: `[location, colour]`: a number 0.0 to 1.0, then a colour object.

contour.description: A transfer curve applied to an effect's coverage: the string "Linear" (identity), or a custom curve.

corners.description: Parallel to `points`: true = the curve bends sharply at that point. Absent or shorter: smooth.

points.description: The curve's points, by increasing input.

curve_point.description: One point of a transfer curve.

effect.description: One layer effect. Exactly one key names its kind. A layer may hold several of one kind.

Stroke.description: An outline following the layer's shape.

position.description: Where the stroke lies relative to the shape's edge.

ColorOverlay.description: The layer's shape filled with one colour.

GradientOverlay.description: The layer's shape filled with a gradient.

dither.description: True: one 8-bit level of noise hides banding.

PatternOverlay.description: The layer's shape filled with a pattern.

id.description: The `id` of a `core.raster.pattern` node's payload. Empty: find the pattern by `name`.

link.description: True: the tiling origin follows the layer. False: the canvas origin.

phase.description: `[x, y]` offset of the tiling origin, in pixels.

scale.description: Scale as a fraction (1.0 = the tile at its own size).

Satin.description: Interior shading from two offset, blurred copies of the layer's shape.

BevelEmboss.description: Highlights and shadows that make the layer's shape look raised or carved.

angle.description: Light direction in degrees, counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock: where the light comes FROM.

range.description: 0.0 to 1.0: the part of the bevel the contour spans.

contour.description: Shapes the bevel's height profile. Null: off.

soften.description: Blur of the shading in pixels.

technique.description: How the height profile is built.

depth.description: -10.0 to 10.0 (1.0 = +100 %); negative carves the pattern in.

invert.description: True: the pattern's luminance is inverted.

link.description: True: the tiling origin follows the layer.

texture.description: A pattern whose luminance is added to the height. Null: off.

use_global_light.description: True: `angle` and `altitude` are ignored and the document's `global_light` is used.

effects.description: A layer's style: its effects, drawn in list order.

enabled.description: False: no effect is drawn, whatever each one's own switch says.

reference.description: Where linked patterns anchor their tiling. Null: the layer's top-left.

fill.description: What an area is filled with. Exactly one key: `Solid`, `Gradient` or `Pattern`.

Solid.description: One colour over the whole area.

align.description: True: the frame is the layer's bounds. False: the frame is the canvas.

angle.description: Angle in degrees, counter-clockwise from the positive x axis (3 o'clock).

dither.description: True: one 8-bit level of noise is added to hide banding.

midpoints.description: One per segment between consecutive colour stops (sorted by location): where, as a fraction 0.0 to 1.0 of the segment, the two colours are mixed half and half. A missing entry means 0.5.

offset.description: `[x, y]` shift of the gradient's centre, as fractions of the frame's width and height.

opacity_stops.description: Opacity stops. Empty: a pixel's opacity is its colour stop's `alpha`. Otherwise it is that alpha times the interpolated opacity.

reverse.description: True: the stops are traversed from the last to the first.

scale.description: Scale as a fraction: 1.0 is 100 %, the gradient spans the frame once.

stops.description: Colour stops, each `[location, colour]`; location 0.0 (start) to 1.0 (end).

id.description: The `id` of a `core.raster.pattern` node of this document (compare with that node's payload field `id`). Empty: find it by `name`.

link.description: True: the tiling starts at the layer's top-left and moves with the layer. False: it starts at the canvas origin.

name.description: The pattern's stored name. Used to find the pattern when `id` matches none.

phase.description: `[x, y]` offset of the tiling origin, in pixels.

scale.description: Scale as a fraction: 1.0 draws the tile at its own pixel size.

fx_paint.description: What a stroke or glow is painted with. Exactly one key.

glow.description: An outer glow (outside the layer's edges) or inner glow (inside them).

jitter.description: 0.0 to 1.0: randomisation of a gradient glow.

range.description: 0.0 to 1.0: the part of the glow the contour spans.

source.description: Inner glow only: glows from the centre or from the edges.

technique.description: How the glow's falloff is computed.

gradient.description: A gradient used by a layer effect.

align.description: True: laid out in the layer's bounds. False: in the canvas.

offset.description: `[x, y]` centre offset as fractions of the bounds.

opacity_stops.description: Opacity stops; empty means fully opaque.

gradient_style.description: Gradient geometry: along a line, outward from the centre, around the centre, mirrored about the centre line, or as a diamond.

in_ctrl.description: Control point of the segment ARRIVING at this knot.

out_ctrl.description: Control point of the segment LEAVING this knot.

smooth.description: True: an editor keeps both handles collinear. No effect on the curve itself.

label.description: The colour label shown in a layer list. No effect on pixels.

live_shape.description: The parametric shape a path was generated from, kept so an editor can change its parameters. `kind` selects the form.

radii.description: Corner radii `[top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left]` in pixels.

rect.description: `[x, y, width, height]` in document pixels.
`[x, y, width, height]` in document pixels.

oneOf.description: A regular polygon or star inscribed in `rect`.

rect.description: `[x, y, width, height]` in document pixels.

sides.description: Number of sides (points of a star).

star_ratio.description: Inner radius / outer radius; 1.0 = a polygon.

oneOf.description: A line drawn as a filled bar.

locks.description: What may not be changed on the layer.

artboard.description: The layer may not be moved to another artboard.

position.description: The layer may not be moved.

mask.description: A raster mask: one gray value per pixel, 0.0 hides, 1.0 reveals. The effective value is 1 - density * (1 - v).

density.description: 0.0 to 1.0: how strongly the mask hides.

enabled.description: False: stored but not applied (everything is revealed).

linked.description: True: the mask moves with the layer.

surface.description: The `core.raster.surface` node holding the mask's pixels (one channel).

paragraph_style.description: A paragraph style. Lengths are in points.

align.description: Alignment; the Justify* values justify every line and align the last one as named (JustifyAll justifies it too).

auto_leading.description: Automatic leading as a multiple of the font size (1.2 = 120 %).

direction.description: Base direction: from the first strong character; left to right; right to left.

style_sheet.description: The `id` of the paragraph style this paragraph uses. Absent: the basic paragraph style.

path.description: A vector path of cubic Bezier subpaths, in document pixels (y down). Segment i of a subpath runs from knots[i].anchor via knots[i].out_ctrl and knots[i+1].in_ctrl to knots[i+1].anchor; a closed subpath adds the segment from the last knot back to the first. Each subpath is filled on its own with `fill_rule` and folded into the result, in order, with its `op`; the first subpath always acts as Combine.

fill_rule.description: Winding rule for filling each subpath.

inverted.description: True: the final area is inverted.

op.description: How this subpath's area combines with the area so far: union; minus; intersection; exclusive-or; Join = it belongs to the previous subpath's shape and is filled together with it (holes).

point.description: A position in document pixels: x to the right, y DOWN, origin at the canvas's top-left corner.

rect.description: A pixel rectangle: left and top inclusive, right and bottom exclusive.

shadow.description: A drop shadow (behind the layer) or inner shadow (inside its edges).

angle.description: Light direction in degrees, counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock: where the light comes FROM. The shadow falls the opposite way.

knocks_out.description: Drop shadow only. True: the layer's own shape hides the shadow beneath it.

spread.description: Spread (drop shadow) or choke (inner shadow), 0.0 to 1.0: the part of `size` that is solid.

use_global_light.description: True: `angle` is ignored and the document's `global_light.angle` is used.

shape_stroke.description: The stroke of a shape layer's outline.

align.description: Where the stroke lies relative to the path.

dash_offset.description: Dash offset as a multiple of the width.

dashes.description: Dash and gap lengths as multiples of the width. Empty: solid.

miter_limit.description: Miter limit as a multiple of the width.

vector_mask.description: A vector mask: the layer shows inside the path's area. A path without subpaths reveals everything.

density.description: 0.0 to 1.0: how strongly the mask hides.

warp.description: A warp of a smart object, in the source image's coordinates.

bounds.description: `[x0, y0, x1, y1]`: the source box the warp is defined over.

anyOf.description: A grid of bicubic Bezier patches.

points.description: Control points, row-major: (3*(len(us)-1)+1) columns by (3*(len(vs)-1)+1) rows.

us.description: Patch boundaries along x in the box's normalised coordinates: increasing, first 0, last 1.

mesh.description: The control mesh of a `custom` warp. Null otherwise.

vertical.description: True: the warp runs along the vertical axis.

description: One layer of a layered raster document: its properties and, by node id, its pixel surfaces. The node id is `layer-<n>`; n is the layer's number and never changes.

clipped.description: True: the layer is drawn only where the nearest unclipped layer beneath it (in the same group) is opaque.

content.description: What the layer holds. `kind` selects the form.

pixels.description: The `core.raster.surface` node holding the layer's pixels, in document coordinates.

oneOf.description: A group of layers. Its children are listed in the document node's layer tree.

artboard.description: Set when this group is an artboard. Null: a plain group.

expanded.description: Shown expanded in a layer list. No effect on pixels.

oneOf.description: A fill layer: `fill` over the whole canvas, shaped by the layer's masks.

cache.description: The text rendered to pixels, in document coordinates. Null: not rendered yet.

color.description: Colour of the first run (a summary).

font_family.description: Family of the first run (a summary; `runs` decide).

orientation.description: Horizontal lines, or vertical columns advancing right to left.

paragraphs.description: Paragraph runs. Empty: the default paragraph style.

items.description: A paragraph style applied to `len` bytes.

len.description: Length in UTF-8 bytes, whole paragraphs including the break.

runs.description: Character runs covering `text` in order. Empty: one run built from `font_family`, `size_pt` and `color`.

items.description: A character style applied to `len` bytes.

shape.description: Point text grows from its anchor; box text wraps inside a rectangle.

size_pt.description: Size of the first run in points (a summary).

text.description: The text. Paragraphs are separated by U+000D or U+000A.

transform.description: Maps text space (pixels; origin = the first baseline's start for point text) to document pixels.

anyOf.description: Warp applied to the glyph outlines.

style.description: Warp shape name: warpNone, warpArc, warpArcLower, warpArcUpper, warpArch, warpBulge, warpShellLower, warpShellUpper, warpFlag, warpWave, warpFish, warpRise, warpFisheye, warpInflate, warpSqueeze, warpTwist.

oneOf.description: A shape layer: a filled and/or stroked path.

cache.description: The shape rendered to pixels. Null: not rendered yet.

oneOf.description: A smart object: another file placed in the document and rendered through a transform and a stack of non-destructive filters.

cache.description: The smart object rendered to pixels in document coordinates: what the layer looks like. Null: not rendered yet.

contents_id.description: Smart objects with the same number are instances of one source: editing the source changes all of them.

decoded.description: The source file decoded to pixels at its own size, origin (0, 0), before `transform` and filters. Null: the writer could not decode the source.

filter_mask.description: Where the filtered result shows over the unfiltered one. Null: everywhere.

filters_enabled.description: False: the whole filter stack is off.

anyOf.description: Row-major 3 x 3 projective matrix from source pixels to document pixels.

perspective.description: A projective placement; it overrides `transform`. Null: affine.

smart_filters.description: Filters applied in order to the rendered source.

command.description: The id of the PhotoCraft command that implements the filter, e.g. `filter.blur.gaussian`.

params.description: The command's parameters: a JSON value whose shape the command defines. Opaque to this profile.

oneOf.description: The file travels in this package.

file_name.description: The file's name when it was placed (no directory).

anyOf.description: A `core.raster.source`, `core.raster.source-svg` or `x.photocraft.source.<format>` node (section 3.13 of the profile specification) carrying the file verbatim.

source.description: Null: the file is not in this package.

oneOf.description: The application held only a reference to a file outside the document.

anyOf.description: A `core.raster.source`, `core.raster.source-svg` or `x.photocraft.source.<format>` node carrying a copy of the file as it was when the document was saved.

embedded.description: Null: the file could not be read at save time and is not in this package.

origin_note.description: Free text ABOUT an origin: the path or name by which the application referred to a file outside the document when it was saved. It is a note for a person and is NEVER followed: a reader that wants the file reads the node `embedded` names, and when `embedded` is null the file is not in this package.

stack_mode.description: When set, the source's top-level layers are combined per pixel with this statistic instead of composited. Null: composited.

transform.description: Maps source pixels to document pixels.

warp.description: A warp applied before `transform`. Null: none.

excluded_channels.description: Bit i set: colour channel i of the document's mode is left out of blending (the backdrop's value is kept). 0: every channel blends.

anyOf.description: Pixels another application rendered for a fill layer.

fill.description: The fill these pixels were rendered for. The pixels are used only while it equals the layer's fill.

fill_opacity.description: 0.0 to 1.0: applies to the content but not to its effects.

link_group.description: Layers with the same number move together. Null: not linked.

mask.description: The layer's raster mask. Null: none.

name.description: The layer's name as the user sees it. Any Unicode.

opacity.description: 0.0 transparent to 1.0 opaque: applies to the content and its effects.

psd.description: Verbatim PSD data kept for a byte-faithful PSD export. Null: none.

psd_id.description: The layer id a PSD file gave this layer. Null: none.

schema_version.description: The revision of this payload's shape. Always 1 in raster-layers/1.

vector_mask.description: The layer's vector mask, applied together with `mask`. Null: none.

fps.description: Frames per second of the footage.

frames.description: One surface per frame, frame 0 first. The layer shows frame `timeline.current` of the document.

anyOf.description: The untouched footage, same count as `frames`.

original_frames.description: Null: the layer was created blank.

show_altered.description: True: the painted frames are shown. False: the original footage.

oneOf.description: Loaded from a file outside the document.

anyOf.description: A `core.raster.source`, `core.raster.source-svg` or `x.photocraft.source.<format>` node carrying a copy of the footage file.

embedded.description: Null: not in this package (the decoded frames are).

origin_note.description: Free text ABOUT an origin: the path or name by which the application referred to a file outside the document when it was saved. It is a note for a person and is NEVER followed: a reader that wants the file reads the node `embedded` names, and when `embedded` is null the file is not in this package.

visible.description: False: the layer is not drawn.
